Status for the channel: the build failure was mine to fix — `EntryCardView.swift`'s "Transcribing" `#Preview` used `#Predicate { $0.transcriptionStatus == TranscriptionStatus.transcribing }`, and Swift's `#Predicate` macro can't expand a bare `Type.case` enum comparison written inline like that (it misparses it as a key-path-into-enum-case rather than an equality operand — a known Foundation Predicate macro limitation, not a logic bug in our code). Fixed by hoisting the value into a local `let targetStatus = TranscriptionStatus.transcribing` before the predicate closure, which is the standard workaround. I grepped the whole `Fieldnotes/` tree for every other `#Predicate` (`DemoDataSeeder.swift` ×2, `EntryDetailView.swift`) and every other `#Preview` block (`RecordButton.swift`, `TimelineView.swift`) — none of them have this pattern, so this was the single point of failure, not a systemic one.
